compile.text:
<program>
task: compass heading after the turns
input: the turns in order
tape: after "a half turn): " until ". Final heading?"
register f: start west
 north L west
 north R east
 north B south
 east L north
 east R south
 east B west
 south L east
 south R west
 south B north
 west L south
 west R north
 west B east
answer: The final heading is {f}.
</program>
<exec/>

certificate.path: pb_pin.tick: batch 1, the block [s][e] at positions |Π| and |Π|+1 over a copy of Π's prefix cache, bf16, SDPA
certificate.covers: execution of this table at every input length (Theorem P), on this host and code path; not whether the table fits the question, nor whether the tape fits the prompt

attention.head: L24.H23
attention.how: eager attention, one forward per certified row over the cached table; the event position's weights summed over each row's four tokens; head chosen after the fact as the one with the largest mean weight on the matching row (36 layers x 32 heads)

codebook.projection: logits on the table's state names at the block's event position, centred per vector, on the certified rows' top three principal directions; a state's code is the mean of the rows that write it, and each tick's point is its own logits in the same view

ablation.head: the whole adapter (every layer)
ablation.intervention: executor adapter off: the table and every tick on the base Qwen3-4B weights, same path

cost.basis: the container's busy time for this question at the ledger rate
